titulo.alumno: «Il nuovo sportello digitale»: inferring vocabulary and purpose

intro: Read this municipal notice about the opening of a digital assistance service carefully. Analyse the purpose of the initiative, the tasks assigned to the operator and the exceptions to in-person service.

palabras.consejo: Plural adjective with a single ending.
Regular verb of the first conjugation.

texto: Pay attention to the limits of the service: the operator assists and explains the procedures, but does not replace the citizen (**non compila le domande al posto dell'utente**).
Notice the conditions of access: **gratuito** (free), **su prenotazione** (by appointment), and the booking for solemn procedures (**resta necessario presentarsi allo sportello tradizionale**).

frases.estudio: Da lunedì il municipio apre uno sportello digitale per aiutare i cittadini a usare i servizi online.
frases.alumno: From Monday the town council is opening a digital service desk to help citizens use the online services.
analisis: from Monday the town council opens

frases.estudio: L'operatore non compila le domande al posto dell'utente, ma spiega i passaggi necessari.
frases.alumno: The operator does not fill in the applications in place of the user, but explains the necessary steps.
analisis: the operator does not fill in the applications

frases.estudio: Controlla inoltre che i documenti digitalizzati siano perfettamente leggibili.
frases.alumno: He also checks that the digitised documents are perfectly legible.

frases.estudio: Il servizio è gratuito e funziona su prenotazione dal martedì al giovedì.
frases.alumno: The service is free and operates by appointment from Tuesday to Thursday.

frases.estudio: Chi non ha un indirizzo email può crearne uno con l'assistenza dell'operatore.
frases.alumno: Anyone who does not have an email address can create one with the help of the operator.
analisis: chi non ha un indirizzo email
anyone who does not have an email address
with the help of the operator

frases.estudio: Per pratiche che richiedono una firma ufficiale, resta necessario presentarsi allo sportello tradizionale.
frases.alumno: For procedures that require an official signature, it is still necessary to go in person to the traditional counter.
analisis: to go in person to the traditional counter

piezas.titulo: Vocabulary: public services and new technologies

pregunta.texto: What is the main aim of the new municipal service?

opciones.texto: To help residents use the official online services independently.
opciones.explicacion: The text states: «per aiutare i cittadini a usare i servizi online».

opciones.texto: To fill in and sign all the administrative applications on behalf of residents.
opciones.explicacion: It is expressly clarified that the official does not fill in the applications for the user.

opciones.texto: To permanently replace all the traditional offices in the city.
opciones.explicacion: The traditional in-person service remains operational for procedures that require a signature.

pregunta.texto: What concrete task does the digital counter operator carry out?

opciones.texto: Guides people through the necessary steps and checks that the scanned documents are legible.
opciones.explicacion: It explains the procedures and checks that the files «siano perfettamente leggibili».

opciones.texto: Keeps all taxpayers' personal bank passwords.
opciones.explicacion: It does not manage private financial keys.

opciones.texto: Charges a cash fee at the entrance of the room for each enquiry.
opciones.explicacion: The service is completely free.

pregunta.texto: What does the indication that the service «funziona su prenotazione» mean?

opciones.texto: That it is essential to book an appointment in advance to be attended on the days indicated.
opciones.explicacion: It requires an advance booking of a slot from Tuesday to Thursday.

opciones.texto: That only residents born in the municipality may attend.
opciones.explicacion: It does not discriminate by place of birth.

opciones.texto: That assistance is given only by recorded video conference.
opciones.explicacion: Assistance is given physically in the municipal room with a booked appointment.

pregunta.texto: What option is offered to a citizen who has no email account?

opciones.texto: They can open an email account with the technical guidance of the operator.
opciones.explicacion: The text specifies: «può crearne uno con l'assistenza dell'operatore».

opciones.texto: They must give up carrying out any procedure with the public administration.
opciones.explicacion: Direct support is given to help them overcome the digital divide.

opciones.texto: A financial penalty is imposed for lacking computer equipment.
opciones.explicacion: There is no penalty at all; access is made easier for them.

pregunta.texto: In what circumstances is it still compulsory to go to the traditional counter?

opciones.texto: When the administrative procedure requires a handwritten or official in-person signature.
opciones.explicacion: The text stipulates: «per pratiche che richiedono una firma ufficiale, resta necessario presentarsi».

opciones.texto: Whenever the user has a laptop computer and their own phone.
opciones.explicacion: In exactly those cases the online digital route can be used.

opciones.texto: Only on Friday afternoons when the building closes to the public.
opciones.explicacion: The traditional offices serve during their ordinary administrative hours.

pregunta.texto: Why is this technical check essential?

frase.texto: L'operatore controlla che i documenti digitalizzati siano perfettamente leggibili.

opciones.texto: To guarantee that the attached files can be processed without reading errors.
opciones.explicacion: Legibility is an indispensable condition for the file to proceed.

opciones.texto: To delete all documents that do not belong to the transport company.
opciones.explicacion: These are municipal citizen procedures, not transport matters.

opciones.texto: Because the municipal system bans scanning blank documents in black and white.
opciones.explicacion: It checks the visual quality of the file, not the colour.

frase.texto: Per completare la pratica telematica, i documenti devono essere perfettamente ___.

opciones.texto: leggibili
opciones.explicacion: Plural adjective agreeing with «documenti».

opciones.texto: leggibile
opciones.explicacion: It is the singular form («un documento leggibile»).

opciones.texto: letto
opciones.explicacion: It is the past participle of the verb leggere.
